config_before.ARM: cr (arm of record); arm A is CAMB with its own recombination
config_before.note_defining: LEAFSCALES/ZSTART/STACKPERT/VISLEAF are ACOUSTIC_two_arm.py switches; neither CAMB nor HIER has them, so each is written out as null.

config_after.ARM: per row: armB_* are HIER on the arm of record (split clock, the cr arm's construction); armA_exact is CAMB on one clock (the leaf rate) and carries no ARM switch
config_after.note_defining: LEAFSCALES/ZSTART/STACKPERT/VISLEAF are ACOUSTIC_two_arm.py switches; neither CAMB nor HIER has them, so each is written out as null.

clock.armA_exact: one clock: the leaf rate (content-carrying Friedmann rate) for grid, projection, perturbations and recombination -- stock CAMB with its own Recfast (r7691+70.1: H_CAMB/H_leaf = 1 to 0.2%, z = 10..1e5)
clock.armB_frozen: split: grid, Hc_of and projection on the stacking rate, ionisation history on the leaf rate (HIER SPLITCLOCK=1)
clock.armB_decoupled: split: grid, Hc_of and projection on the stacking rate, ionisation history on the leaf rate (HIER SPLITCLOCK=1)

config_after.note_r7693: re-keyed at r7693 (69 approved, r7691+70.1 proposal): SPLITCLOCK and ARM were bank-wide and true of the arm-B rows only; arrays untouched
